summary: BUG: Work Order Print – Only First Page of Lines Prints (Remaining Lines Missing)
reported_issue: Using browser Print on a Work Order page, the print preview only includes the first page of work order lines; lines beyond the first page do not appear. Regression from previously-working behavior.
expected_after_fix: All Work Order lines should appear across multiple pages in the print output.
steps_i_followed: As admin, opened Work Order S2-15522 (id 06747f14...), which has 21 lines (72 rendered table rows including labor/parts/story sub-rows).
Emulated print media (equivalent to browser Print) and generated a print-to-PDF of the page.
Inspected the PDF page count and the print-media rendering of the lines table (row visibility and the scroll container's overflow).
actual_now: All lines print across multiple pages. The print-to-PDF produced 4 pages (not clipped to 1). In print media all 72 line rows are visible (visibleRows=72 of 72), the last line row renders, and the lines scroll container ('.q-table__middle') has overflow:visible with full expanded height (3102px) rather than a clipped fixed-height scroll region. This matches expected_after_fix - the print CSS now expands the lines table so every line flows across pages instead of being cut off after the first page.
notes: Root-cause pattern (scroll container clipping in print) is resolved: print media sets overflow:visible and full height, and the paginated PDF spans 4 pages for the 21-line WO.
